title: Pending cards act on the invite's real state, not a blind Confirm of a guess
deviations_from_card: Added a seventh card kind `closed` (last invite declined / no_show -> primary reinvite, via the same send-link door) because liveInviteFor's closed-only pick needs a state and calling a decline 'expired' would be untrue. Added `bookControlFor(state)` so case 8 pins the single data-sim-click="confirm" control's label/emphasis from the resolver rather than a kind gate. Added `send_link` to AGENDA_VERBS/EFFECTS ({refetchEntries:false, notify:true}; mintLink shared with reinvite) and extended scheduleAgenda.test.ts case 5's verb list by it. The grid seed now uses liveInviteFor too (the last-row-wins Map is gone). Accept-in-place reuses scheduleTab.lifecycle.acceptProposal / proposalsGroupAria copy. Extra catalog keys beyond sendLink.*: sendLink.action/refused and cardState.* (13 keys), appended at the end of scheduleTab in all four catalogs in one commit under the lock. perf-budget.json app/page.tsx raised by this card's measured share only (+1 module / +16.5 KB, 1386/8825 -> 1387/8842) under the lock. sharedGet.ts header reworded (its real sibling pair today is useAttention + useChannelsData on /api/attention).
notes: i18n:check exit 1 only on a sibling's AUTOMATION_SELECTION_INVALID (api-response.ts, not mine) at the time of the check; my keys pass (and case 7 asserts them in all four catalogs). tsc: zero errors in my files; whole-tree red only on sibling/kpi-sim paths (decisions ScreenWave, SimControlDock, jobs tests, kpi-sim/). test:unit: 2 BROKEN, both foreign: recipes-literals (pipeline/PassPreviewModal.tsx noticeAmber 2>1) and rate-limit-contract (jds/[slug]/ingest-job). test:perf: after my raise app/page.tsx still reads 1388/8863 vs 1387/8842 -- the remaining +1 module / +21 KB is sibling in-flight growth; the api/**/route.ts override lines are sibling app/_lib growth. eslint: 0 errors, 1 pre-existing exhaustive-deps warning (mount-load effect, same as base). Not browser-verified (no dev server per brief). Note for integration: someone overwrote my scratchpad catalogs.mjs with a pipeline-actions-events catalog script (shared scratchpad path) -- harmless to my commits, but that script refuses unless the catalog round-trips byte-identically, which it currently does not.
